scope: Search degradation investigation; sanitized production logs and bounded public-query probes

confirmed.googleScholar: One direct production-host public-fixture request returned HTTP 403; no proxy discovery, redirects, retries or CAPTCHA bypass
confirmed.saveAccepted: Normal asynchronous best-effort admission was concatenated with search degradation warnings

probeConstraints.queries: Fixed public graph-neural-network terms, never user queries

codeFindings: DBLP deadline and stop support not forwarded by topic/title/DOI dispatch

LLM search can ignore selected sources

limitations: Google Scholar direct availability is currently HTTP403; the earlier request's exact failure path is not established and Semantic Scholar log co-matches were not treated as attribution

No production user search was replayed and no paid query-analysis request was made
No credentials, raw user queries, response bodies, or raw private logs are included
